source: Actual Edge browser. Controlled fixtures explicitly simulate progress/generation failures and latency; one separate browser run uses the actual configured provider and backend progress. No questionnaire saved.

checks.name: while the request is pending, the process panel shows the submitted requirements and real elapsed time
stages advance only after actual simulated server events, including validation and completion
a failed regeneration preserves the previous draft and inputs, and retry works
unavailable detailed progress does not block normal generation
polling failure is quiet and leaves the generated draft usable
a clarification response is presented as a request for more information
the active process panel fits mobile and light themes
the real configured provider drives the real progress panel and returns a design summary
